long_biography.plain_text:
United Group began as a cable network in central Serbia and grew by combining broadband, pay television, mobile services and media across southeastern Europe. Šolak founded the original business in 2000, helped assemble regional operators under one group and guided it through successive international investment partnerships. The platform established his reputation as a telecommunications founder and became the foundation for his later investing.

Born in Kragujevac, Šolak studied electronics in Belgrade before leaving university to pursue business. An earlier production company introduced him to media and rights management, experience he later applied to subscription television and communications infrastructure. His capital allocation has since broadened into sports and entertainment through Sport Republic, where he is lead investor and chairman of a multi-club and sports-technology portfolio.
